paragraph:
Seeds of a bargain
Agricultural innovation needs institutions that can learn as well as laboratories that can invent

An article set at the fictional Vale Agricultural Institute.

Dry channels (striate) the (desolate) valley around the new institute. Beyond a laboratory roofed in (slate), contractors (corrugate) metal sheets for a storage shed. Leaking oil threatens to (maculate) the entrance before the opening ceremony. The government promises to transform the region into a centre of agricultural technology. For now, the transformation remains partly under construction.

An (expatriate) scientist invites visitors to (perambulate) the experimental gardens. She hopes the institute will (affiliate) with foreign universities, (amalgamate) scattered research teams and (repatriate) a historic seed collection held abroad. These are plausible ambitions. Their value will depend on whether knowledge reaches the farmers living beyond the perimeter fence.

The launch is less restrained. Critics call its spending (profligate); sponsors (inflate) their forecasts and (adulate) the minister. Promises of exceptional returns can (inebriate) an audience without the assistance of wine. The danger is that officials will (immolate) public finances on the altar of technological prestige before establishing what the research can deliver.

The underlying problems are serious. Feed shortages (emaciate) cattle, pests can (decimate) crops, and debt threatens to (asphyxiate) small businesses. Better systems to (irrigate) fields could help (mitigate) losses. But a research institute cannot, by its existence alone, repair credit markets, transport networks or the distribution of reliable advice.

Its scientific activities require careful explanation. Contractors may (fumigate) storage areas; researchers may deliberately (defoliate) experimental plants. Other teams use equipment to (irradiate) samples or racks on which to (insolate) materials. Journalists should (differentiate) these procedures. Treating every unfamiliar process as either a miracle or a menace makes informed scrutiny harder.

Inside, a microscope reveals a (ciliate) beside a (flagellate). In other cultures, microorganisms (pullulate). A veterinary team studies conditions affecting how blood will (coagulate), while researchers investigate whether one compound can (potentiate) another’s effects. This variety is a strength, provided funding decisions distinguish useful inquiry from an impressive catalogue of activities.

The institute also trains people. Students (matriculate) from districts where scientific careers once seemed remote. Teachers must do more than (invigilate) examinations: pupils need to (assimilate) concepts and (articulate) what they do not understand. Veterinary trainees preparing to (inoculate) livestock require supervised practice. Human capability is part of the infrastructure, even when it photographs less well than equipment.

Research standards will determine credibility. Scientists may (postulate) that a new variety tolerates difficult conditions, but must (substantiate) the claim. A successful trial does not justify attempts to (extrapolate) without limit. Models can (interpolate) between observations, yet actual farms may (deviate) from their assumptions. Uncertainty should travel with the result when it leaves the laboratory.

Fieldwork supplies the necessary correction. Teams (modulate) irrigation, track temperatures that (oscillate), and measure how water will (percolate) through soil. They examine where salts (accumulate) and how seedlings (acclimate). A disappointing harvest can be valuable evidence. Concealing it would turn an experimental programme into a publicity operation.

Land policy is more contentious. Parliament can (appropriate) funds, but proposals to (expropriate) neighbouring plots raise questions the scientific presentation cannot answer. Existing equipment may (depreciate) before displaced growers find new work. Authorities should (regulate) acquisition transparently and (stipulate) what support affected households will receive. Compensation deserves a schedule, not merely a sympathetic speech.

The minister wants to (promulgate) special rules for the institute. Legislators should examine what they are being asked to (legislate). A desire for speed does not justify permission to (abrogate) inconvenient agreements or (derogate) from established protections. Nor should an appointed director (arrogate) powers that belong to elected institutions.

The institute’s charter promises to serve smallholders. It must not instead (subjugate) them to a single buyer or (emasculate) local councils. Independent oversight could (insulate) research from commercial pressure, though it would not (obviate) every conflict. Whether the project helps (alleviate) insecurity will depend partly on who can challenge its decisions.

A nearby (renunciate), who has abandoned worldly possessions, offers surprisingly practical criticism. Ceremonies, he says, can become an (opiate) for administrators. They may (palliate) resentment without correcting its causes. Donors cannot (expiate) years of neglect merely by financing a commemorative plaque. They might usefully (sublimate) their desire for recognition into patient support for unglamorous work.

The minister prefers a larger stage. He carefully tries to (enunciate) the names of new technologies, promises to (denunciate) vested interests and proceeds to (expatiate) on future prosperity. Asked about operating costs, he begins to (speculate) about export valuations. The change of subject can (discombobulate) even sympathetic listeners. Revenue is not the same thing as a working budget.

Opponents are equally capable of excess. Farmers (castigate) the land office; a newspaper editor threatens to (excoriate) everyone involved. Neither has a licence to (calumniate) researchers whose findings they dislike. Personal attacks can (infuriate) staff and tempt managers to (retaliate) against critics. Such exchanges make mistakes harder to acknowledge and therefore harder to correct.

The institute should explain which organisations it will (associate) with and when it would (dissociate) itself from a partner. If misconduct emerges, it must (repudiate) it without trying to (expurgate) inconvenient reports. Executives who (dissimulate) to preserve the appearance of unity risk destroying the trust on which collaboration depends.

An independent commission could (mediate) disputes over access and pricing. Its task would be to (conciliate) parties with legitimate disagreements, rather than (propitiate) the most powerful participant. People must be allowed to (expostulate) when arrangements fail. The present (stalemate) is unlikely to end while one side can rewrite the conditions under which the other complains.

A practical beginning would be to (initiate) a limited programme with published objectives. Evidence of abuse should be sufficient to (instigate) an inquiry. Results should (circulate) beyond academic journals, and extension workers should (relate) them to local conditions. A short summary can (encapsulate) findings without pretending that every farmer faces the same choices.

Managers should also (ventilate) grievances before they become crises. Suppressing criticism can (vitiate) the entire review process; weak accounting may allow an official to (peculate) funds intended for farmers. Months of unexplained delay can (excruciate) families awaiting compensation. An (inanimate) dashboard will record the overdue payment, but somebody must still take responsibility for resolving it.

None of this requires researchers to (capitulate) to every objection. Nor should ministers (vacillate) whenever a trial disappoints. They should (recapitulate) what has been learned, (emulate) arrangements that work and resist the urge to (conflate) criticism with hostility to progress. The institute will have succeeded when the surrounding farms become better able to withstand a bad year.
translation:
播下合作的种子
农业创新既需要能够发明的实验室，也需要能够学习的制度

本文以虚构的维尔农业研究院为背景。

干涸的水渠在新研究院周围(荒凉的)山谷里(划出一道道条纹)。一间屋顶铺着(板岩)的实验室外，承包商正在把金属板(压成波纹状)，用于搭建储物棚。开幕式尚未举行，泄漏的机油就可能(污损)入口。政府承诺把这一地区变成农业技术中心。目前，这场转型仍有一部分处于施工状态。

一位(侨居国外的)科学家邀请来访者(漫步参观)试验园。她希望研究院能与外国大学(建立合作关系)，(合并)分散的研究团队，并将一批保存在海外的历史种子收藏(运回祖国)。这些目标是可信的。其价值将取决于知识能否传递到围栏之外的农民手中。

发布会则不那么克制。批评者称其开支(挥霍无度)，赞助商(夸大)预测，并对部长(谄媚吹捧)。非凡回报的承诺，无须借助葡萄酒，也能让听众(陶醉)。危险在于，官员们可能尚未弄清研究能够带来什么，就把公共财政作为祭品，在技术声望的祭坛上(焚毁)。

实际问题十分严重。饲料短缺使牛群(消瘦衰弱)，虫害可能(大量毁坏)庄稼，债务则可能使小企业(窒息)。更好的农田(灌溉)系统，有助于(减轻)损失。但一家研究院，不能仅凭自身存在，就修复信贷市场、交通网络或可靠咨询服务的供给体系。

其科研活动需要谨慎解释。承包商可能对储存区进行(熏蒸消毒)，研究人员可能有意使试验植物(落叶)。其他团队使用设备对样品进行(辐照)，或使用架子将材料(暴晒于阳光下)。记者应当(区分)这些程序。把每一种陌生过程都当成奇迹或威胁，只会让有根据的审视更加困难。

室内，显微镜显示出一个(纤毛虫)，旁边是一个(鞭毛虫)。在其他培养物中，微生物正在(大量繁殖)。一个兽医团队研究影响血液(凝固)的条件，另一些研究者则调查一种化合物能否(增强)另一种化合物的作用。这种多样性是一项优势，前提是拨款决策能够区分有用的探索与一份令人印象深刻的活动清单。

研究院也培养人才。学生从那些曾经觉得科研职业遥不可及的地区前来(注册入学)。教师必须做的不只是(监考)：学生需要(理解吸收)概念，并(清楚表达)自己不懂的地方。准备为牲畜(接种)的兽医学员，需要接受有监督的实践训练。人的能力也是基础设施的一部分，即使它没有设备那么上镜。

研究标准将决定可信度。科学家可以(假定)一个新品种能够耐受恶劣条件，但必须(提供证据证实)这一主张。一次成功试验，并不足以支持无限制地(外推)。模型可以在观测值之间进行(插值估算)，但实际农场可能(偏离)模型的假设。当结果离开实验室时，不确定性也应当随之呈现。

田野研究提供了必要的校正。团队(调节)灌溉，追踪(波动)的温度，并测量水如何(渗透)土壤。他们考察盐分在哪里(积累)，以及幼苗如何(适应环境)。一次令人失望的收成，也可能是宝贵证据。隐瞒它，会把试验项目变成宣传活动。

土地政策更具争议。议会可以(拨出)资金，但(征收)邻近地块的提议，会引出科学演示无法回答的问题。在失去土地的种植者找到新工作之前，现有设备可能已经(贬值)。当局应当透明地(规范)征地，并(明确规定)受影响家庭将获得什么支持。赔偿需要时间表，而不只是一场充满同情的演说。

部长希望为研究院(颁布)特别规则。立法者应当仔细审查，他们究竟被要求就什么内容(立法)。追求速度，并不能成为允许(废除)不方便的协议，或(减损)既有保障的正当理由。一个受任命的院长，也不应(擅取)属于民选机构的权力。

研究院章程承诺为小农户服务。它不能反而使他们(受制于)单一买家，或(削弱)地方议会的权力。独立监督可以使研究(免受)商业压力影响，尽管无法(消除)每一项冲突。项目能否帮助(缓解)不安全感，部分取决于谁有权质疑其决定。

附近一位舍弃了世俗财产的(出世修行者)，提出了出人意料地务实的批评。他说，仪式可能成为行政人员的(精神麻醉剂)。它们或许能(暂时缓和)怨愤，却不纠正怨愤的根源。捐赠者不能仅仅出资制作一块纪念牌，就为多年的忽视(赎罪)。他们倒是可以把追求认可的欲望(升华转化)为对那些不够光鲜的工作的耐心支持。

部长更喜欢大舞台。他努力把新技术的名称(清晰念出)，承诺(公开谴责)既得利益，随后开始(详尽阐述)未来的繁荣。当被问及运营成本时，他又开始(猜测)出口估值。这样的转移话题，即使对抱有善意的听众，也可能造成(困惑)。收入与可执行的运营预算，并不是一回事。

反对者同样可能过火。农民(严厉斥责)土地管理部门，一位报纸编辑扬言要(痛批)所有涉事者。但任何一方都无权因为不喜欢某些研究结论，就(诽谤)研究人员。人身攻击可能(激怒)员工，并诱使管理者对批评者(报复)。这种交锋让错误更难得到承认，也就更难得到纠正。

研究院应当解释，它将与哪些组织(联合合作)，以及在什么情况下会与某个伙伴(脱离关系)。如果出现不当行为，它必须(明确拒斥)，而不能试图(删去)令人不便的报告。为了维持团结的表象而(掩饰真相)的高管，可能摧毁合作赖以维系的信任。

一个独立委员会可以(调解)准入与定价争议。它的任务应当是让存在合理分歧的各方(和解)，而不是(讨好安抚)其中最有权势的一方。当安排失效时，必须允许人们(提出强烈异议)。只要一方仍能改写另一方提出投诉所须遵循的条件，当前的(僵局)就不太可能结束。

一个务实的起点，是(启动)一项规模有限、目标公开的计划。有滥用行为的证据，就应足以(促成)调查。结果应当在学术期刊之外(传播)，农业推广人员则应把这些结果与本地条件(联系起来)。一份简短摘要可以(概括)研究发现，而不必假装每个农民面对的选择都一样。

管理者还应当在不满演变成危机之前，让其得到(公开讨论)。压制批评可能(损害)整个审查程序；薄弱的财务管理，则可能让官员(侵吞)原本用于农民的资金。数月没有解释的拖延，可能使等待赔偿的家庭(饱受煎熬)。一块(没有生命的)仪表盘会记录逾期付款，但仍然必须有人负责解决它。

所有这些，都不要求研究人员对每一项反对意见(屈服)。部长们也不应每逢试验结果令人失望，就(摇摆不定)。他们应当(概述回顾)已经获得的认识，(效仿)行之有效的安排，并克制把批评与敌视进步(混为一谈)的冲动。当周围农场更有能力挺过歉收年时，研究院才算取得了成功。

本批词根亮点：

• -gate 大家族：fumigate/irrigate/mitigate/castigate/instigate/subjugate/promulgate/abrogate/arrogate/expurgate，全来自拉丁 agere（驱使/做）+前缀，gate=驱使

• excruciate：ex（加强）+ crux（十字架），像被钉在十字架上=极度痛苦，crucify（钉十字架）/crucial（关键=十字路口）同根

• propitiate：来自 propitius（有利的），古罗马通过祭祀平息众神，propitious（吉祥）同根

• vitiate：vitium（缺陷/罪），vitiate=引入缺陷=损害，vice（恶习）同根

• emaciate：e+macer（瘦），极度消瘦，macrobiotic（长寿=细长的生命）同根

• decimate：deci（十分之一），古罗马军法中对叛乱士兵每十人杀一人，decimation=杀十分之一，decimal（小数）同根

• oscillate：来自拉丁 oscillum（秋千），秋千摆动=振荡，oscillator 振荡器

• sublimate：sub（在下）+ limate（升起），物质从固态直接升为气态=升华，心理学引申为将欲望升华为创造力

quiz.question: profligate ________
quiz.explanation: 挥霍的，挥霍的开支。The government's profligate spending led to a severe budget deficit. 政府的挥霍开支导致了严重的预算赤字。 | pro->向前，flig->打击（拉丁fligere），profligate->被打倒的=堕落的/挥霍的（cf. afflict折磨，conflict冲突，inflict施加，profligacy挥霍） || 文化联想：《红楼梦》里贾府奢靡排场、挥金如土的生活最适合帮助记忆 profligate，可以说 **profligate spending — “The lavish banquets, gifts, and household expenses of a great aristocratic clan can become an example of profligate spending.”**

quiz.question: fumigate _____
quiz.explanation: 熏蒸消毒，熏蒸消毒房屋。They had to fumigate the house after discovering termites. 发现白蚁后他们不得不对房屋进行熏蒸消毒。 | fum->烟（拉丁fumus），gate->驱使，fumigate->用烟驱除虫害（cf. fume烟/愤怒，fumigation熏蒸，perfume香水=通过烟，fumarole火山气孔） || 文化联想：南方老宅发现白蚁后常需要整屋熏蒸处理，最适合联想到 fumigate，可以说 **fumigate the house — “After termites are found in an old wooden house, pest-control workers may fumigate the house to eliminate the infestation.”**

quiz.question: irrigate ______
quiz.explanation: 灌溉，灌溉田地。Farmers must irrigate fields regularly during the dry season. 农民必须在旱季定期灌溉田地。 | ir->进入，rig->水流（拉丁rigare->浇水），irrigate->引水进入=灌溉（cf. irrigation灌溉，arid干旱，riga拉脱维亚首都=水边的城市） || 文化联想：都江堰把岷江水引入成都平原灌溉农田，最适合帮助记忆 irrigate，可以说 **irrigate the fields — “For centuries, the Dujiangyan system has diverted water to irrigate the fields of the Chengdu Plain.”**

quiz.question: mitigate ____
quiz.explanation: 减轻，减轻风险。The company implemented new safety protocols to mitigate risk. 公司实施了新的安全规程以减轻风险。 | mit->温和（拉丁mitis->温和），gate->使，mitigate->使温和=减轻（cf. mild温和，mitigate缓和，unmitigated没有减轻的，mitigation缓解） || 文化联想：古代治河时修堤、分洪来降低水患风险，最适合联想到 mitigate，可以说 **mitigate flood risk — “Building levees and diversion channels can help mitigate flood risk along a major river.”**

quiz.question: castigate __________
quiz.explanation: 严厉批评，严厉批评腐败。The editorial continued to castigate corruption among high-ranking officials. 这篇社论继续严厉批评高级官员中的腐败。 | caste->纯洁（拉丁castus），gate->使，castigate->使变纯洁=惩戒（cf. chaste纯洁，chastise惩戒，chastity贞洁，castigate严厉批评） || 文化联想：御史上奏弹劾贪官、严厉斥责腐败最适合帮助记忆 castigate，可以说 **castigate corruption — “An imperial censor might use a memorial to castigate corruption among powerful officials.”**

quiz.question: instigate ________
quiz.explanation: 煽动，煽动暴力。Authorities arrested the agitator for attempting to instigate violence. 当局逮捕了试图煽动暴力的煽动者。 | in->进入，stig->刺（拉丁instigare->刺激），instigate->刺激使行动=煽动（cf. stigma烙印，instigation煽动，agitate鼓动，provoke激怒） || 文化联想：陈胜吴广起义故事里煽动民众反抗秦朝的情节很适合联想到 instigate，可以说 **instigate rebellion — “A rebel leader may use fiery speeches and rumors to instigate rebellion against an unpopular regime.”**

quiz.question: promulgate ___
quiz.explanation: 颁布，颁布法律。The legislature voted to promulgate law protecting workers' rights. 立法机构投票颁布保护工人权利的法律。 | pro->向前，mulg->公告（拉丁mulgare->公开），promulgate->向公众宣告=颁布（cf. promulgation颁布，publish发布，proclaim宣布，proclamation宣告） || 文化联想：古代朝廷把新律令正式昭告天下，最适合联想到 promulgate，可以说 **promulgate a law — “After approving a new statute, the court could promulgate the law through official proclamations and local notices.”**

quiz.question: abrogate _ ______
quiz.explanation: 废除，废除条约。The new administration threatened to abrogate a treaty that had been in place for decades. 新政府威胁要废除已实施数十年的条约。 | ab->离开，rog->要求（拉丁rogare），abrogate->撤回要求=废除（cf. arrogate僭取，derogate贬损，prerogative特权，interrogate审讯） || 文化联想：王朝更替后废除前朝旧法令的场景很适合联想到 abrogate，可以说 **abrogate an old law — “A new dynasty might abrogate an old law that no longer fit its political order.”**

quiz.question: derogate ____
quiz.explanation: 贬损，贬损。Such behavior would derogate from the dignity of the office. 这种行为会贬损该职位的尊严。 | de->向下，rog->要求（拉丁），derogate->向下要求=贬低（cf. abrogate废除，arrogate僭取，interrogate审讯，derogatory贬义的） || 文化联想：官员如果行为失当，会“有损官体”，最适合帮助记忆 derogate，可以说 **derogate from the dignity of office — “A corrupt or disgraceful act can derogate from the dignity of public office.”**

quiz.question: arrogate _____
quiz.explanation: 僭取，僭取权力。The dictator continued to arrogate power that rightfully belonged to the parliament. 独裁者继续僭取本应属于议会的权力。 | ar->朝向，rog->要求，arrogate->要求本不属于自己的=僭取（cf. arrogant傲慢=僭取过多，prerogative特权，abrogate废除，arrogance傲慢） || 文化联想：王莽等历史人物被指擅自攫取本不属于自己的权力，很适合联想到 arrogate，可以说 **arrogate power — “A ruler who seizes powers not lawfully granted to him may arrogate power to himself.”**

quiz.question: expurgate _ ____
quiz.explanation: 删除，删除书中不当内容。The publisher decided to expurgate a book before releasing it to younger readers. 出版商决定在向年轻读者发行前删除书中不当内容。 | ex->向外，purg->净化（拉丁purgare），expurgate->净化向外=删除不当内容（cf. purge清除，purify净化，pure纯，expurgation删节） || 文化联想：古籍重印时把被认为不宜公开的段落删去，可以帮助记忆 expurgate，可以说 **expurgate a text — “An editor preparing a censored edition of an old book may expurgate passages considered improper for publication.”**

quiz.question: subjugate _ ______
quiz.explanation: 征服，征服一个民族。The empire's attempt to subjugate a people led to decades of resistance. 帝国试图征服一个民族导致了数十年的抵抗。 | sub->在下，jug->轭（拉丁jugum），subjugate->置于轭下=征服（cf. conjugal婚姻=共同的轭，jugular颈静脉，yoga瑜伽=结合，yoke轭） || 文化联想：秦灭六国、把各国置于统一统治之下的历史场景很适合联想到 subjugate，可以说 **subjugate rival states — “The Qin armies defeated and subjugated the rival states before unifying China in 221 BCE.”**

quiz.question: corrugate _________
quiz.explanation: 使起皱，瓦楞纸板。The factory workers corrugate cardboard to create stronger packaging material. 工厂工人制作瓦楞纸板以生产更坚固的包装材料。 | cor->共同，rug->皱纹（拉丁ruga），corrugate->使出现皱纹=使起皱（cf. corrugated iron瓦楞铁，ruga皱纹，corrugation波纹状） || 文化联想：快递纸箱里常见的瓦楞夹层最适合帮助记忆 corrugate，可以说 **corrugated cardboard — “Modern delivery boxes are often made from corrugated cardboard whose ridged inner layer gives the package extra strength.”**

quiz.question: emaciate ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 使消瘦，使身体消瘦。Prolonged illness can emaciate the body severely. 长期疾病会严重使身体消瘦。 | e->向外，maci->瘦（拉丁macies），emaciate->使极度消瘦（cf. macrobiotic长寿=细长生命，lean瘦，gaunt消瘦，emaciated骨瘦如柴） || 文化联想：古代灾荒或久病让人骨瘦如柴的形象很适合联想到 emaciate，可以说 **emaciate the body — “Prolonged famine or illness can emaciate the body until the face and limbs appear painfully thin.”**

quiz.question: depreciate ______
quiz.explanation: 贬值，资产贬值。Companies must depreciate assets over time according to accounting standards. 公司必须根据会计准则使资产随时间贬值。 | de->向下，preci->价值（拉丁pretium），depreciate->使价值向下=贬值（cf. appreciate升值，precious珍贵，price价格，appraise评估） || 文化联想：现代企业会按年对机器、车辆等固定资产计提折旧，最适合联想到 depreciate，可以说 **depreciate an asset — “A factory may depreciate a machine over several years as its accounting value gradually falls.”**

quiz.question: enunciate _______
quiz.explanation: 清晰发音，清晰地发音。The speech therapist taught the child to enunciate clearly. 语言治疗师教孩子清晰地发音。 | e->向外，nunci->宣告（拉丁nuntiare），enunciate->向外宣告=清晰发音（cf. announce宣布，pronounce发音，renounce放弃，denunciate谴责） || 文化联想：说书、评书讲究吐字清楚，最适合帮助记忆 enunciate，可以说 **enunciate clearly — “A skilled storyteller must enunciate clearly so that every listener in the teahouse can follow the tale.”**

quiz.question: denunciate __________
quiz.explanation: 谴责，谴责腐败。Activists gathered to denunciate corruption in the government. 活动人士聚集谴责政府的腐败。 | de->向下，nunci->宣告，denunciate->向下宣告=公开谴责（cf. denounce谴责，announce宣布，renounce放弃，enunciate发音） || 文化联想：古代御史公开弹劾贪腐官员的场景很适合联想到 denunciate，可以说 **denunciate corruption — “A censor who openly condemns bribery and abuse of office may denunciate corruption before the court.”**

quiz.question: renunciate _______ _______
quiz.explanation: 放弃，放弃世俗欲望。The monk chose to renunciate worldly desires. 这位僧侣选择放弃世俗欲望。 | re->回，nunci->宣告，renunciate->宣告回归=正式放弃（cf. renounce放弃，denounce谴责，announce宣布，pronunciation发音） || 文化联想：佛教出家人舍弃世俗欲望的传统最适合帮助记忆 renunciate，可以说 **renunciate worldly desires — “A monk entering religious life may renunciate worldly desires in order to pursue spiritual discipline.”**

quiz.question: associate _________
quiz.explanation: 副的，副教授。Dr. Smith was promoted to associate professor after publishing her research. 史密斯博士在发表研究成果后晋升为副教授。 | as->朝向，soci->伙伴（拉丁socius），associate->与伙伴联系=同事/副（cf. society社会，social社交，socialize社交，dissociate分离） || 文化联想：中国高校里的“副教授”就是 associate professor，最适合帮助记忆 associate，可以说 **an associate professor — “After years of teaching and research, a scholar may be promoted to associate professor at a Chinese university.”**

quiz.question: dissociate _______
quiz.explanation: 分离，使自己分离。The politician tried to dissociate oneself from the controversial remarks. 政客试图使自己与有争议的言论分离。 | dis->分开，soci->伙伴，dissociate->分开伙伴关系=分离（cf. associate联系，dissociation分离，society社会，cf. dissociative解离性） || 文化联想：发生争议后有人公开表示“与此事划清界限”，最适合联想到 dissociate，可以说 **dissociate oneself from something — “A public figure may issue a statement to dissociate himself from remarks he says he does not support.”**

quiz.question: excruciate __ ____
quiz.explanation: 使痛苦，因痛苦而折磨。The injury continued to excruciate by pain throughout the night. 这个伤口整夜都因痛苦折磨着他。 | ex->加强，crux->十字架（拉丁），excruciate->像被钉上十字架一样=极度折磨（cf. crucify钉十字架，crucial关键=十字路口，cross十字，excruciating剧烈的） || 文化联想：中文“痛不欲生”最适合帮助记忆 excruciate，可以说 **excruciating pain — “A severe injury that causes pain so intense that a person can barely think may be described as excruciating pain.”**

quiz.question: irradiate ____
quiz.explanation: 照射，照射食物。Scientists irradiate food to extend its shelf life. 科学家照射食物以延长保质期。 | ir->向内，radi->光线（拉丁radius），irradiate->向内照射（cf. radiation辐射，radiate发射，ray光线，eradiate发出光芒） || 文化联想：现代食品工业用辐照延长某些食品保质期，可以帮助记忆 irradiate，可以说 **irradiate food — “Food processors may irradiate certain products to reduce microbes and extend shelf life.”**

quiz.question: mediate ________
quiz.explanation: 调解，调解冲突。The diplomat was called in to mediate conflict between the two nations. 外交官被召来调解两国冲突。 | medi->中间（拉丁medius），mediate->在中间=调解（cf. median中位数，media媒体，medieval中世纪=中间时代，immediate立即=无中间） || 文化联想：乡里纠纷请德高望重的长者居中调解，最适合联想到 mediate，可以说 **mediate a dispute — “A respected village elder may mediate a dispute between two families before it turns into a larger feud.”**

quiz.question: repudiate _____
quiz.explanation: 否认，否认声明。The company moved quickly to repudiate claim made by its former employee. 公司迅速否认前雇员的声明。 | re->回，pud->羞耻（拉丁pudor），repudiate->将其视为羞耻而拒绝=否认（cf. impudent无耻，pudency羞耻，repudiation否认） || 文化联想：中文“断然否认”最适合帮助记忆 repudiate，可以说 **repudiate a claim — “An official who says an accusation is completely false may publicly repudiate the claim.”**

quiz.question: retaliate __ ____
quiz.explanation: 报复，以同样方式报复。When attacked, the nation chose to retaliate in kind. 受到攻击时，该国选择以同样方式报复。 | re->回，tali->以眼还眼（拉丁talis->同等的），retaliate->以同等方式回应=报复（cf. talion同态复仇，retaliation报复，revenge报复） || 文化联想：“以牙还牙，以眼还眼”这种同等方式报复最适合帮助记忆 retaliate，可以说 **retaliate in kind — “If one side answers an insult or attack with the same kind of action, it is choosing to retaliate in kind.”**

quiz.question: ciliate ________
quiz.explanation: 有纤毛的，有纤毛的原生动物。Under the microscope, we observed ciliate protozoa moving through the water sample. 在显微镜下我们观察到有纤毛的原生动物在水样中移动。 | cili->睫毛（拉丁cilium），ciliate->有纤毛的（cf. cilium纤毛，ciliary睫状体，supercilious傲慢=眉毛高扬，eyelash睫毛） || 文化联想：中学生物课观察草履虫时能看到表面密布纤毛，最适合帮助记忆 ciliate，可以说 **a ciliate protozoan — “Under a microscope, a paramecium is a ciliate protozoan covered with tiny hairs that help it move through water.”**

quiz.question: conciliate _________
quiz.explanation: 安抚，安抚对手。The leader's strategy was to conciliate opponents rather than confront them. 领导者的策略是安抚对手而不是直接对抗。 | con->共同，cili->议会（拉丁concilium），conciliate->召开议会和解=安抚（cf. council议会，reconcile和解，irreconcilable不可调和，conciliation安抚） || 文化联想：“以和为贵”最适合帮助记忆 conciliate，可以说 **conciliate an opponent — “A negotiator who values harmony may offer concessions to conciliate an opponent rather than prolong the quarrel.”**

quiz.question: affiliate _______
quiz.explanation: 附属，附属项目。The university launched an affiliate program with several international institutions. 该大学与国际机构启动了附属项目。 | af->朝向，fili->儿子（拉丁filius），affiliate->收为儿子=使附属（cf. filial孝顺，filicide杀子，filiation血统，affiliate联盟成员） || 文化联想：中国大学与附属医院、附属中学的关系最适合帮助记忆 affiliate，可以说 **an affiliated institution — “A university hospital may be an affiliated institution that shares teaching, research, and training programs with the university.”**

quiz.question: palliate ________
quiz.explanation: 缓解，缓解症状。The medication can only palliate symptoms but not cure the disease. 这种药物只能缓解症状但不能治愈疾病。 | palli->披风（拉丁pallium），palliate->用披风覆盖=掩盖/缓解（cf. palliative缓解性的，pallor苍白，cloak掩盖，palliative care姑息治疗） || 文化联想：中医里有些药只能缓解疼痛、咳嗽等症状，并不能治本，很适合联想到 palliate，可以说 **palliate the symptoms — “A remedy may palliate the symptoms and make a patient more comfortable even if it does not cure the underlying illness.”**

quiz.question: defoliate ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 使落叶，使树木落叶。The chemical agent was designed to defoliate the trees in enemy territory. 这种化学制剂旨在使敌方领土上的树木落叶。 | de->去除，foli->叶子（拉丁folium），defoliate->使叶子脱落（cf. foliage叶子，folio对折纸，portfolio作品集，defoliation落叶） || 文化联想：秋风或虫害让树木大片落叶的场景很适合联想到 defoliate，可以说 **defoliate the trees — “A severe caterpillar outbreak can defoliate the trees until their branches are almost bare.”**

quiz.question: calumniate _ _____
quiz.explanation: 诽谤，诽谤对手。It is unethical to calumniate a rival in order to gain political advantage. 为了政治优势而诽谤对手是不道德的。 | calumni->诽谤（拉丁calumnia），calumniate->故意诽谤（cf. calumny诽谤，calumnious诽谤性的，slander诽谤，defame损毁名誉） || 文化联想：古代奸臣用谗言中伤忠臣最适合帮助记忆 calumniate，可以说 **calumniate a rival — “A scheming courtier might calumniate a rival by spreading false accusations to ruin his reputation.”**

quiz.question: opiate ________
quiz.explanation: 鸦片类药物，鸦片类药物过量。Emergency rooms have seen a dramatic increase in opiate overdose cases. 急诊室看到鸦片类药物过量病例急剧增加。 | opium->鸦片（希腊opos->汁液），opiate->鸦片制剂（cf. opium鸦片，opioid类鸦片，overdose过量，morphine吗啡=Morpheus睡眠之神） || 文化联想：鸦片战争和晚清鸦片问题最适合帮助记忆 opiate，可以说 **opiate addiction — “The spread of opiate addiction became a major social and political concern in nineteenth-century China.”**

quiz.question: expiate _____
quiz.explanation: 赎罪，赎罪。He spent years trying to expiate guilt over his past mistakes. 他花了多年时间为过去的错误赎罪。 | ex->向外，pi->虔诚（拉丁pius），expiate->通过虔诚行为清除罪孽=赎罪（cf. piety虔诚，pious虔诚，impious不虔诚，expiation赎罪） || 文化联想：廉颇“负荆请罪”主动认错并弥补过失，最适合联想到 expiate，可以说 **expiate one’s guilt — “By humbling himself and asking Lin Xiangru for forgiveness, Lian Po sought to expiate his guilt.”**

quiz.question: inebriate ______
quiz.explanation: 醉酒的，醉酒的司机。Police arrested an inebriate driver after a routine traffic stop. 警方在例行交通检查后逮捕了醉酒的司机。 | in->使，ebri->醉（拉丁ebrius->醉），inebriate->使醉=醉酒的（cf. inebriated醉酒，sobriety清醒，sober清醒，temperance节制） || 文化联想：酒驾查处是中国人很熟悉的现代场景，最适合联想到 inebriate，可以说 **an inebriate driver — “Police may stop an inebriate driver whose alcohol level makes it unsafe and illegal to remain on the road.”**

quiz.question: excoriate ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 严厉批评，严厉批评政策。Opposition leaders continued to excoriate the policy as harmful to workers. 反对派领导人继续严厉批评该政策对工人有害。 | ex->去除，cori->皮肤（拉丁corium），excoriate->剥皮=严厉批评（cf. corium真皮，coroner验尸官，leather皮革，excoriate痛斥） || 文化联想：鲁迅杂文常以尖锐笔锋猛烈批评社会弊病，很适合联想到 excoriate，可以说 **excoriate a social evil — “A sharp satirical essay may excoriate a social evil with language meant to sting and provoke reflection.”**

quiz.question: appropriate _____
quiz.explanation: 拨款，拨款。Congress voted to appropriate funds for disaster relief. 国会投票为救灾拨款。 | ap->朝向，propr->自己的（拉丁proprius），appropriate->使成为自己的=占用/拨款（cf. proper适当，property财产，propriety礼仪，expropriate征用） || 文化联想：灾害发生后政府拨出专项救灾资金，最适合帮助记忆 appropriate，可以说 **appropriate funds — “A government may appropriate funds for emergency housing, food, and reconstruction after a major disaster.”**

quiz.question: expropriate ____
quiz.explanation: 征用，征用土地。The government moved to expropriate land for the new highway project. 政府采取行动为新高速公路项目征用土地。 | ex->向外，propr->自己的，expropriate->使不再是自己的=征用（cf. appropriate占用，property财产，proper合适，propriety礼仪） || 文化联想：修高速公路或水库时依法征用土地的场景最适合联想到 expropriate，可以说 **expropriate land — “For a major infrastructure project, authorities may expropriate land under a legal compensation process.”**

quiz.question: repatriate ________
quiz.explanation: 遣返，遣返难民。International agencies worked to repatriate refugees to their home countries. 国际机构努力将难民遣返回本国。 | re->回，patri->父亲/祖国（拉丁pater），repatriate->送回祖国=遣返（cf. patriarch族长，paternal父亲的，patrician贵族，expatriate外籍人） || 文化联想：战乱结束后让流离海外的人返回祖国，最适合联想到 repatriate，可以说 **repatriate displaced people — “After a conflict ends, authorities may help repatriate displaced people who wish to return to their home country.”**

quiz.question: expatriate ______
quiz.explanation: 外籍的，外籍工人。The company hired an expatriate worker with extensive international experience. 公司雇用了一名具有丰富国际经验的外籍工人。 | ex->离开，patri->祖国，expatriate->离开祖国的人=外籍人（cf. repatriate遣返，patriot爱国者，paternal父亲的，compatible兼容） || 文化联想：上海、深圳等城市里的外籍员工最适合帮助记忆 expatriate，可以说 **an expatriate worker — “A multinational company in Shanghai may employ an expatriate worker who has moved to China for an overseas assignment.”**

quiz.question: striate ______
quiz.explanation: 有条纹的，横纹肌。The anatomy textbook showed detailed diagrams of striate muscle tissue. 解剖学教科书展示了横纹肌组织的详细图表。 | stri->条纹（拉丁stria->沟槽），striate->有条纹的（cf. striated striped有条纹，stripe条纹，striation条纹，stria沟槽） || 文化联想：人体解剖图里横纹肌一条条明暗相间，最适合联想到 striate，可以说 **striated muscle — “Under magnification, skeletal muscle appears as striated muscle with repeating light and dark bands.”**

quiz.question: infuriate ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 激怒，激怒人群。The speaker's insensitive remarks served only to infuriate the crowd. 演讲者不敏感的言论只会激怒人群。 | in->使，furi->愤怒（拉丁furia），infuriate->使愤怒=激怒（cf. fury愤怒，furious愤怒，furor公众愤怒，fusillade连续射击） || 文化联想：中文“火上浇油”最适合帮助记忆 infuriate，可以说 **infuriate the crowd — “An arrogant remark made during a tense protest can infuriate the crowd and make the situation far harder to control.”**

quiz.question: expatiate __
quiz.explanation: 详述，详述。The professor began to expatiate on the complexities of quantum mechanics. 教授开始详述量子力学的复杂性。 | ex->向外，pati->漫步（拉丁spatiari），expatiate->向外漫步=详细阐述（cf. spacious宽敞，space空间，spatial空间的，expatiate详述） || 文化联想：老师讲《红楼梦》人物关系时一讲就是半堂课，很适合联想到 expatiate，可以说 **expatiate on a topic — “A literature professor may expatiate on the Jia family’s decline for an entire lecture.”**

quiz.question: initiate _ _______
quiz.explanation: 启动，启动项目。The committee voted unanimously to initiate a project focused on renewable energy. 委员会一致投票启动一个专注于可再生能源的项目。 | init->开始（拉丁initium->起点），initiate->进入开始=启动（cf. initial最初，initiative主动，initiation入会，initial letter首字母） || 文化联想：大型工程开工仪式宣布项目正式启动，最适合帮助记忆 initiate，可以说 **initiate a project — “A city may initiate a new subway project after planning, funding, and approval are complete.”**

quiz.question: propitiate ____
quiz.explanation: 抚慰，抚慰神灵。Ancient civilizations performed rituals to propitiate gods and ensure good harvests. 古代文明举行仪式抚慰神灵以确保丰收。 | propiti->有利（拉丁propitius），propitiate->使有利于自己=平息（cf. propitious吉祥，propitiatory安抚的，favorable有利，auspicious吉祥） || 文化联想：传统祭祀中献香、供品以求神灵保佑风调雨顺，很适合联想到 propitiate，可以说 **propitiate the gods — “In an old harvest ritual, villagers might offer incense and food to propitiate the gods and pray for favorable weather.”**

quiz.question: vitiate ________
quiz.explanation: 损害，损害合同。The lawyer argued that fraud would vitiate contract and render it invalid. 律师辩称欺诈会损害合同使其无效。 | vitium->缺陷/罪（拉丁），vitiate->引入缺陷=损害（cf. vice恶习，vicious恶毒，vitiated受损的，virtuous有美德=无缺陷） || 文化联想：合同如果建立在欺诈之上，就可能失去效力，最适合联想到 vitiate，可以说 **vitiate a contract — “Fraud or coercion can vitiate a contract by undermining the validity of the agreement.”**

quiz.question: substantiate _____
quiz.explanation: 证实，证实声明。The researcher provided extensive evidence to substantiate claim. 研究人员提供了大量证据来证实该声明。 | sub->在下，stanti->站立（拉丁），substantiate->站得住脚=证实（cf. substance实质，substantial实质性的，substitute替代，constant恒定） || 文化联想：中文“有根有据”最适合帮助记忆 substantiate，可以说 **substantiate a claim — “A historian must use documents, inscriptions, or other evidence to substantiate a claim about the past.”**

quiz.question: differentiate ________
quiz.explanation: 区分，区分特征。It can be difficult to differentiate features between the two similar species. 很难区分两个相似物种之间的特征。 | differ->不同，entiate->使，differentiate->使不同=区分（cf. differ不同，different不同，indifferent漠然，differential差分） || 文化联想：品茶时辨别龙井、碧螺春等不同茶叶的香气和形态，很适合联想到 differentiate，可以说 **differentiate two varieties — “An experienced tea drinker can differentiate two varieties by their aroma, leaf shape, and flavor.”**

quiz.question: potentiate ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 增强，增强效果。Certain drugs can potentiate the effect of alcohol in the bloodstream. 某些药物可以增强血液中酒精的效果。 | potent->有力（拉丁potens），iate->使，potentiate->增强效力（cf. potential潜力，potent有力，impotent无力，omnipotent全能） || 文化联想：中药与西药同时使用时有时可能增强彼此作用，这可以帮助记忆 potentiate，可以说 **potentiate an effect — “Combining two medicines can sometimes potentiate an effect, which is why drug interactions must be checked carefully.”**

quiz.question: obviate ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 消除，消除需要。The new software will obviate the need for manual data entry. 新软件将消除手动输入数据的需要。 | ob->对抗，vi->道路（拉丁via），obviate->挡在路上=消除障碍（cf. obvious明显=在路上，devious弯路=偏离，previous之前，via经由） || 文化联想：有了高铁电子票后，不再需要纸质车票的场景很适合联想到 obviate，可以说 **obviate the need for something — “Electronic ticketing can obviate the need for a printed train ticket in many situations.”**

quiz.question: deviate ____ ____
quiz.explanation: 偏离，偏离道路。The pilot was forced to deviate from path due to severe weather. 由于恶劣天气飞行员被迫偏离航路。 | de->离开，vi->道路（拉丁via），deviate->离开道路=偏离（cf. devious迂回，obvious明显，previous之前，via经由，deviation偏差） || 文化联想：“离经叛道”里的“离开正道”很适合帮助记忆 deviate，可以说 **deviate from the path — “A person who abandons an agreed course and goes his own way may deviate from the path set by the group.”**

quiz.question: alleviate ____
quiz.explanation: 减轻，减轻疼痛。The doctor prescribed medication to alleviate pain after surgery. 医生开了药以减轻手术后的疼痛。 | al->使，levi->轻（拉丁levis），alleviate->使变轻=减轻（cf. levitate悬浮=变轻，lever杠杆，relief减轻，levity轻浮） || 文化联想：针灸、理疗或药物都可能用来减轻疼痛，很适合联想到 alleviate，可以说 **alleviate pain — “A patient may use medicine, physiotherapy, or other treatment to alleviate pain after an injury.”**

quiz.question: asphyxiate ______
quiz.explanation: 使窒息，使受害者窒息。Toxic fumes threatened to asphyxiate victim trapped inside. 有毒烟雾威胁要使困在里面的受害者窒息。 | a->无，sphyx->脉搏（希腊sphyzein->脉搏），asphyxiate->无脉=窒息（cf. asphyxia窒息，suffocate使窒息，choke窒息，stifle压制） || 文化联想：火灾现场浓烟会让被困人员窒息，最适合帮助记忆 asphyxiate，可以说 **asphyxiate a victim — “In a building fire, dense smoke can asphyxiate a trapped victim before the flames ever reach them.”**

quiz.question: relate _____
quiz.explanation: 讲述，讲述故事。The elderly woman began to relate story of her childhood during the war. 老妇人开始讲述她战争期间的童年故事。 | re->回，lat->携带（拉丁latus），relate->携带回来=讲述/联系（cf. relation关系，relative亲戚，relative相对，narrate叙述） || 文化联想：老人给晚辈讲抗战、知青或童年经历的场景最适合联想到 relate，可以说 **relate a story — “At a family gathering, an elderly relative may relate a story from childhood that younger generations have never heard.”**

quiz.question: inflate ___ _______
quiz.explanation: 夸大，夸大数字。The report attempted to inflate the numbers to make results appear more impressive. 报告试图夸大数字使结果看起来更令人印象深刻。 | in->进入，flat->吹（拉丁flare），inflate->吹进去=充气/夸大（cf. deflate泄气，flat平的，conflate混淆，flatulence胀气） || 文化联想：中文“注水数据”最适合帮助记忆 inflate，可以说 **inflate the numbers — “A dishonest report may inflate the numbers to make weak results look far more impressive than they really are.”**

quiz.question: conflate _____
quiz.explanation: 混淆，混淆观点。It is a common mistake to conflate ideas that are actually quite distinct. 将截然不同的观点混淆是常见错误。 | con->共同，flat->吹（拉丁），conflate->吹合在一起=混淆（cf. inflate夸大，deflate泄气，flatulent充满气的，conflation合并混淆） || 文化联想：把“儒家”和“所有中国传统思想”混为一谈，就是 conflate 的典型错误，可以说 **conflate two ideas — “It is a mistake to conflate Confucian thought with every other tradition in Chinese philosophy.”**

quiz.question: invigilate __ ____
quiz.explanation: 监考，监考考试。The teacher was assigned to invigilate an exam for the final-year students. 老师被指派监考期末学生的考试。 | in->使，vigil->清醒（拉丁vigil），invigilate->保持清醒看守=监考（cf. vigil守夜，vigilant警惕，vigilance警惕，invigorate振奋） || 文化联想：科举考试里的监临、巡察人员要防止作弊，很适合联想到 invigilate，可以说 **invigilate an examination — “Officials in the imperial examination system had to invigilate the examination and watch closely for cheating.”**

quiz.question: assimilate __________
quiz.explanation: 同化，同化移民。The program was designed to help assimilate immigrants into mainstream society. 该项目旨在帮助移民同化进入主流社会。 | as->朝向，simil->相似（拉丁similis），assimilate->使相似=同化（cf. similar相似，simulate模拟，dissimilar不同，simile明喻） || 文化联想：海外移民进入新的社会后逐渐学习当地语言、习俗和制度，很适合联想到 assimilate，可以说 **assimilate into society — “A newcomer may gradually assimilate into society by learning the language, customs, and everyday norms of the new country.”**

quiz.question: ventilate ____
quiz.explanation: 通风，给房间通风。Open the windows to ventilate room and remove stale air. 打开窗户给房间通风并排出污浊空气。 | vent->风（拉丁ventus），ilate->使，ventilate->使有风=通风（cf. wind风，vent出口，ventilation通风，event事件=风来了） || 文化联想：夏天开窗形成穿堂风给房间换气，最适合帮助记忆 ventilate，可以说 **ventilate a room — “Opening windows on opposite sides of a traditional courtyard house can help ventilate a room and remove stale air.”**

quiz.question: flagellate ____
quiz.explanation: 有鞭毛的，鞭毛细胞。The biology student examined flagellate cell under high magnification. 生物学学生在高倍放大镜下检查鞭毛细胞。 | flagell->鞭子（拉丁flagellum），flagellate->有鞭子的=有鞭毛的（cf. flagellum鞭毛，flagellate鞭打，self-flagellation自我惩罚） || 文化联想：中学生物课观察眼虫时能看到一根帮助运动的鞭毛，最适合联想到 flagellate，可以说 **a flagellate cell — “Under a microscope, a euglena is a flagellate cell that moves with the help of a whip-like flagellum.”**

quiz.question: vacillate _______
quiz.explanation: 犹豫，在两者间犹豫。She continued to vacillate between accepting the job offer and staying at her current position. 她继续在接受工作机会和留在现职位之间犹豫。 | vacill->摇摆（拉丁vacillare），vacillate->摇摆=犹豫不决（cf. waver动摇，hesitate犹豫，oscillate振荡，ambivalent矛盾心理） || 文化联想：中文“举棋不定”最适合帮助记忆 vacillate，可以说 **vacillate between two choices — “Someone who is ‘举棋不定’ may vacillate between two choices and keep delaying a decision.”**

quiz.question: oscillate ______
quiz.explanation: 振荡，剧烈振荡。Stock prices began to oscillate wildly in response to market uncertainty. 股票价格开始剧烈振荡以应对市场的不确定性。 | oscill->秋千（拉丁oscillum），oscillate->像秋千一样摆动=振荡（cf. oscillator振荡器，vacillate犹豫，fluctuate波动，undulate波动） || 文化联想：寺庙大钟被敲响后钟摆来回摆动、声音逐渐衰减，很适合联想到 oscillate，可以说 **oscillate back and forth — “After a large temple bell is struck, its suspended parts may oscillate back and forth before gradually coming to rest.”**

quiz.question: percolate ______
quiz.explanation: 渗透，煮咖啡。The aroma filled the kitchen as the machine began to percolate coffee. 机器开始煮咖啡时香气充满了厨房。 | per->穿透，col->过滤（拉丁colare），percolate->穿透过滤=渗透/煮（cf. filter过滤，percolation渗透，seep渗，trickle细流） || 文化联想：手冲咖啡时热水慢慢渗过滤纸和咖啡粉，最适合帮助记忆 percolate，可以说 **water percolates through coffee grounds — “During pour-over coffee, hot water percolates through the coffee grounds and filter before dripping into the cup.”**

quiz.question: immolate _______
quiz.explanation: 焚烧，自焚。The protester threatened to immolate oneself in front of the government building. 抗议者威胁要在政府大楼前自焚。 | im->在上，mol->磨（拉丁mola->磨石/祭品），immolate->在祭石上奉献=牺牲/焚烧（cf. mole摩尔，molecule分子，immolation献祭） || 文化联想：佛教典籍中“舍身”故事可以帮助理解 immolate 的“献祭/焚毁”义，但不能把它当作普通佛教行为，可以说 **immolate oneself — “In an extreme act of self-sacrifice described in some historical accounts, a person may immolate himself, though such acts are exceptional rather than ordinary practice.”**

quiz.question: extrapolate _____
quiz.explanation: 推断，推断趋势。Economists attempted to extrapolate trend from the limited data available. 经济学家试图从有限数据中推断趋势。 | extra->超出，pol->柱（拉丁polire->磨光），extrapolate->超出已知点推延=推断（cf. interpolate插值，extrapolation外推，interpolation内插） || 文化联想：根据过去几年房价走势继续推算未来趋势，很适合联想到 extrapolate，可以说 **extrapolate a trend — “An analyst may extrapolate a housing-price trend from several years of data, though the projection can still be wrong.”**

quiz.question: interpolate ____
quiz.explanation: 插入，插值数据。The software can interpolate data to fill in missing values. 该软件可以插值数据以填补缺失值。 | inter->之间，pol->磨光，interpolate->在两点之间插入=内插（cf. extrapolate外推，interpose插入，interpolation内插法） || 文化联想：中国中学数学里根据已知点估算中间值就是插值，很适合联想到 interpolate，可以说 **interpolate a value — “Given two measured points, a student may interpolate a value that lies between them.”**

quiz.question: desolate _________
quiz.explanation: 荒凉的，荒凉的景观。The travelers crossed a desolate landscape with no signs of human habitation. 旅行者穿越了荒凉的景观没有人类居住的迹象。 | de->彻底，sol->单独（拉丁solus），desolate->彻底单独=荒凉的（cf. solitude孤独，sole唯一，solo独奏，console安慰=不再孤独） || 文化联想：西北戈壁荒无人烟、一眼望不到村庄的景象最适合联想到 desolate，可以说 **a desolate landscape — “Across parts of the Gobi, a traveler may see a desolate landscape with bare ground, distant hills, and almost no habitation.”**

quiz.question: insolate _______
quiz.explanation: 日晒，晒样品。Researchers needed to insolate samples for several hours to complete the experiment. 研究人员需要晒样品几个小时以完成实验。 | in->使，sol->太阳（拉丁sol），insolate->使暴露在太阳下=日晒（cf. solar太阳的，solstice至点，parasol遮阳伞，insolation日照） || 文化联想：农作物研究中把样品放在阳光下做日照处理，最适合联想到 insolate，可以说 **insolate a sample — “In an agricultural experiment, researchers may insolate a plant sample for a fixed number of hours to study the effect of sunlight.”**

quiz.question: slate _ _________
quiz.explanation: 提名，提名候选人。The party committee decided to slate a candidate for the upcoming election. 党委会决定为即将到来的选举提名候选人。 | slate->石板（古法语esclate），slate->用石板列名=提名（cf. slate清单/石板，clean slate重新开始，slate grey青灰色） || 文化联想：现代选举或组织内部先确定一名候选人参选，可以帮助记忆 slate，可以说 **slate a candidate — “A political organization may slate a candidate after internal discussion and selection.”**

quiz.question: legislate ______
quiz.explanation: 立法，立法改革。Parliament moved quickly to legislate reform in the healthcare system. 议会迅速对医疗保健系统进行立法改革。 | leg->法律（拉丁lex），islate->使，legislate->制定法律=立法（cf. legislature立法机关，legal合法，legislation法规，illegitimate非法） || 文化联想：国家通过立法形式建立新的环保或劳动规则，最适合联想到 legislate，可以说 **legislate reform — “A legislature may legislate reform by passing new rules on labor, environmental protection, or public safety.”**

quiz.question: perambulate _______
quiz.explanation: 巡视，巡视街道。The security guard would perambulate streets throughout the night. 保安会在整个夜晚巡视街道。 | per->穿过，ambul->走（拉丁ambulare），perambulate->穿过走动=巡视（cf. ambulance救护车=走动的，ambulatory门诊的，amble漫步） || 文化联想：古代更夫夜里沿街巡查、报时的场景很适合联想到 perambulate，可以说 **perambulate the streets — “A night watchman in an old Chinese town might perambulate the streets while sounding a clapper to mark the hours.”**

quiz.question: discombobulate _____
quiz.explanation: 使混乱，使计划混乱。The unexpected announcement served to discombobulate plans for the merger. 出乎意料的公告使合并计划变得混乱。 | discombobulate->幽默词（可能来自 discompose+disconcert），使完全混乱（cf. disconcert使困惑，discombobulate搞乱，bamboozle欺骗） || 文化联想：中文“打乱阵脚”最适合帮助记忆 discombobulate，可以说 **discombobulate the plan — “A sudden change in orders can discombobulate the entire plan and leave everyone unsure what to do next.”**

quiz.question: maculate ______
quiz.explanation: 玷污，玷污记录。The scandal threatened to maculate record of an otherwise distinguished career. 丑闻威胁要玷污杰出职业生涯的记录。 | macul->斑点（拉丁macula），maculate->使有斑点=玷污（cf. immaculate无瑕=无斑点，immaculate conception无染原罪，macular黄斑的） || 文化联想：中文“留下污点”最适合帮助记忆 maculate，可以说 **maculate a reputation — “A major scandal can maculate an otherwise distinguished reputation by leaving a stain that is hard to erase.”**

quiz.question: peculate _____
quiz.explanation: 挪用，挪用资金。The treasurer was accused of attempting to peculate funds from the organization. 财务主管被指控试图挪用该组织的资金。 | pecul->私人财产（拉丁pecunia->金钱），peculate->侵占他人财产=挪用（cf. peculiar特别=属于个人的，pecuniary金钱的，peculium私有财产） || 文化联想：贪官偷偷挪用公款最适合帮助记忆 peculate，可以说 **peculate public funds — “A corrupt treasurer who secretly diverts government money for personal use may peculate public funds.”**

quiz.question: speculate __ ______
quiz.explanation: 投机，炒股。Many investors lost money when they chose to speculate on stocks during the market bubble. 许多投资者在市场泡沫期间炒股而亏损。 | spec->观察（拉丁specere），speculate->观察可能性=推测/投机（cf. spectacle景象，inspect检查，respect尊重，spectacular壮观） || 文化联想：中文“炒股投机”是 speculate 最熟悉的现代场景之一，可以说 **speculate on stocks — “During a market bubble, some investors may speculate on stocks simply because they expect prices to keep rising.”**

quiz.question: matriculate __
quiz.explanation: 入学，入学于。She was excited to matriculate at her first-choice university. 她很兴奋能入学于首选大学。 | matric->母亲（拉丁mater），matriculate->进入母亲的怀抱=入学（cf. matrix矩阵=子宫，maternal母亲的，matricide弑母，matron老妇人） || 文化联想：中国大学新生正式注册入学的场景最适合联想到 matriculate，可以说 **matriculate at a university — “After receiving an admission offer and completing registration, a student can matriculate at the university in the fall.”**

quiz.question: articulate _______
quiz.explanation: 善于表达的，善于表达的演讲者。The articulate speaker captivated the audience with her clear arguments. 这位善于表达的演讲者以清晰论点吸引了观众。 | artic->关节（拉丁articulus），articulate->用关节连接=清晰表达（cf. article文章/冠词，joint关节，articulation发音/关节） || 文化联想：中文“能言善辩、条理清楚”最适合帮助记忆 articulate，可以说 **an articulate speaker — “A debater who presents complex ideas in clear, orderly language is an articulate speaker.”**

quiz.question: inoculate ________
quiz.explanation: 接种，给儿童接种。The health department launched a campaign to inoculate children against measles. 卫生部门发起了给儿童接种麻疹疫苗的运动。 | in->进入，ocul->眼/芽（拉丁oculus），inoculate->将芽植入=接种（cf. ocular眼部的，oculist眼科医生，eye眼，oculus圆眼窗） || 文化联想：儿童接种麻疹、乙肝等疫苗的场景最适合帮助记忆 inoculate，可以说 **inoculate children — “A public-health campaign may inoculate children against preventable infectious diseases.”**

quiz.question: circulate _ ____
quiz.explanation: 传阅，传阅备忘录。The manager asked her assistant to circulate a memo about the new policy. 经理要求助理传阅关于新政策的备忘录。 | circ->圆（拉丁circus），circulate->绕圈传递=传阅（cf. circle圆，circuit回路，circumference周长，circus马戏团=圆形场地） || 文化联想：机关内部把文件依次传给各部门阅读，就是 circulate 的典型场景，可以说 **circulate a document — “An office may circulate a policy memo so that every department can read and comment on it.”**

quiz.question: emasculate ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 削弱，削弱法案。Amendments threatened to emasculate the bill and remove its most important provisions. 修正案威胁要削弱法案并删除最重要的条款。 | e->去除，mascul->男性（拉丁masculus），emasculate->去除男性力量=削弱（cf. masculine男性，mascot吉祥物，male男性，castrate阉割） || 文化联想：一项法律如果不断被删掉关键条款，最后可能被“掏空”，最适合联想到 emasculate，可以说 **emasculate a bill — “Removing all of a bill’s enforcement provisions can emasculate the bill until it has little practical effect.”**

quiz.question: adulate _ _________
quiz.explanation: 阿谀奉承，阿谀奉承名人。Fans gathered to adulate a celebrity they had admired for years. 粉丝聚集阿谀奉承他们崇拜多年的名人。 | adul->讨好（拉丁adulari->像狗一样摇尾），adulate->过分奉承（cf. adulation奉承，flattery谄媚，sycophant马屁精，adulatory奉承的） || 文化联想：中文“阿谀奉承”最适合帮助记忆 adulate，可以说 **adulate a powerful person — “A courtier who constantly flatters a powerful official may adulate him in hopes of winning favor.”**

quiz.question: modulate ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 调节，调节音调。Professional singers learn to modulate the tone of their voice for different effects. 专业歌手学习调节音调产生不同效果。 | modul->尺度（拉丁modus），modulate->按尺度调整=调节（cf. module模块，model模型，mode模式，modify修改，mood情绪） || 文化联想：京剧唱腔会通过高低强弱变化来调节声音效果，最适合联想到 modulate，可以说 **modulate the voice — “A Peking-opera singer must modulate the voice carefully to shape pitch, intensity, and emotional color.”**

quiz.question: coagulate _____
quiz.explanation: 凝结，凝结血液。Certain proteins help coagulate blood and stop bleeding from wounds. 某些蛋白质帮助凝结血液并止住伤口出血。 | co->共同，agul->凝固（拉丁coagulare），coagulate->共同凝固=凝结（cf. coagulation凝固，congeal凝固，clot血凝块，curdle凝固） || 文化联想：中医外伤或现代急救都要依靠血液凝固来止血，最适合联想到 coagulate，可以说 **blood coagulates — “After a small cut, the blood gradually coagulates and forms a clot that helps stop the bleeding.”**

quiz.question: regulate ___________
quiz.explanation: 调节，调节温度。The thermostat works automatically to regulate temperature throughout the building. 恒温器自动工作以调节整个建筑物的温度。 | reg->统治（拉丁regere），regulate->按规则统治=调节（cf. regular规则，reign统治，regal皇家，regiment管制，deregulate解除管制） || 文化联想：空调恒温器自动调节室内温度是最直观的 regulate 场景，可以说 **regulate temperature — “A thermostat can regulate indoor temperature by switching heating or cooling on and off as needed.”**

quiz.question: pullulate ____ ____
quiz.explanation: 充满，充满生机。The coral reef seemed to pullulate with life in every crevice. 珊瑚礁的每个缝隙都似乎充满生机。 | pullul->发芽（拉丁pullulare->发芽），pullulate->大量繁殖=充满（cf. proliferate增生，teem充满，swarm群集，abound充满） || 文化联想：南海珊瑚礁鱼群、甲壳类和其他生物密集繁衍的景象很适合联想到 pullulate，可以说 **pullulate with life — “A healthy coral reef can pullulate with life, with fish and small creatures filling nearly every crevice.”**

quiz.question: emulate _ _____
quiz.explanation: 效仿，效仿榜样。Young athletes often try to emulate a model they consider successful. 年轻运动员经常试图效仿他们认为成功的榜样。 | aemul->竞争（拉丁aemulus->竞争者），emulate->与...竞争=效仿（cf. emulation效仿，rival竞争对手，simulate模拟，mimic模仿） || 文化联想：年轻书法家临摹王羲之、颜真卿的作品就是典型 emulate，可以说 **emulate a master — “A young calligrapher may emulate Wang Xizhi by studying and copying the rhythm and structure of his brushwork.”**

quiz.question: dissimulate ________
quiz.explanation: 掩饰，掩饰感情。She learned to dissimulate feelings to maintain her professional demeanor. 她学会了掩饰感情以保持职业风度。 | dis->否定，simul->相似（拉丁），dissimulate->使看起来不同=掩饰（cf. simulate模拟，dissemble掩饰，feign假装，pretend假装） || 文化联想：中文“喜怒不形于色”最适合帮助记忆 dissimulate，可以说 **dissimulate one’s feelings — “Someone trained to keep ‘joy and anger from showing on the face’ may dissimulate his feelings even under pressure.”**

quiz.question: accumulate ______
quiz.explanation: 积累，积累财富。Through careful investing and saving, they managed to accumulate wealth over the years. 通过谨慎投资和储蓄他们多年来成功积累了财富。 | ac->朝向，cumul->堆（拉丁cumulus），accumulate->向堆叠=积累（cf. cumulus积云，cumulate堆积，accumulation积累，reservoir储备） || 文化联想：中文“积少成多”最适合帮助记忆 accumulate，可以说 **accumulate wealth gradually — “The saying ‘small amounts accumulate into much’ describes how a family may accumulate wealth gradually through saving over many years.”**

quiz.question: stipulate _____
quiz.explanation: 规定，规定条款。The contract clearly stipulate terms for payment and delivery. 合同明确规定了付款和交付的条款。 | stipul->茎/条件（拉丁stipulari->议定），stipulate->正式议定=规定（cf. stipulation规定，condition条件，proviso附带条件，clause条款） || 文化联想：合同里白纸黑字明确规定付款日期、违约责任等条款，最适合联想到 stipulate，可以说 **stipulate the terms — “A formal contract should stipulate the payment schedule, delivery date, and consequences of breach.”**

quiz.question: insulate _____
quiz.explanation: 绝缘，使电线绝缘。Electricians must properly insulate wires to prevent electrical hazards. 电工必须正确使电线绝缘以防止电气危险。 | insul->岛（拉丁insula），insulate->使像岛一样隔离=绝缘（cf. island岛，insular岛国的/孤立的，isolate隔离，peninsula半岛） || 文化联想：家庭装修时电线外面包绝缘层防止漏电，最适合帮助记忆 insulate，可以说 **insulate electrical wires — “An electrician must properly insulate electrical wires so that exposed current does not create a shock or fire hazard.”**

quiz.question: encapsulate ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 概括，概括想法。The phrase seemed to perfectly encapsulate the idea he had been trying to express. 这个短语似乎完美地概括了他试图表达的想法。 | en->使，capsul->小容器（拉丁capsula），encapsulate->放入小容器=概括（cf. capsule胶囊，capture捕获，chapter章节，captain队长） || 文化联想：中文“一言以蔽之”最适合帮助记忆 encapsulate，可以说 **encapsulate an idea — “A short proverb can encapsulate an idea that would otherwise require a long explanation.”**

quiz.question: capitulate __ _____
quiz.explanation: 投降，向武力投降。The besieged city was forced to capitulate to force after months of resistance. 被围困的城市在抵抗数月后被迫向武力投降。 | capit->头（拉丁caput），capitulate->低头=投降（cf. capital首都=头，captain队长=头，decapitate斩首，recapitulate再概括） || 文化联想：南宋末年城池被围、粮尽援绝后被迫投降的场景很适合联想到 capitulate，可以说 **capitulate after a siege — “A city cut off from food and reinforcements may eventually capitulate after a long siege.”**

quiz.question: recapitulate ______
quiz.explanation: 概括，概括要点。At the end of the lecture, the professor took time to recapitulate points for clarity. 讲座结束时教授花时间概括要点以求清晰。 | re->再次，capit->头，recapitulate->再次从头整理=概括（cf. capitulate投降，capital首都，captain队长，chapter章节=小头） || 文化联想：老师讲完一堂课后再把几个重点重新概括一遍，最适合联想到 recapitulate，可以说 **recapitulate the main points — “At the end of the lesson, the teacher may recapitulate the main points so students remember the structure of the argument.”**

quiz.question: postulate ______
quiz.explanation: 假定，假定理论。Scientists must postulate theory before conducting experiments to test it. 科学家必须在进行实验测试之前假定理论。 | postul->要求（拉丁postulare），postulate->要求接受=假定（cf. postulation假定，posit假设，axiom公理，hypothesis假设） || 文化联想：中国传统天文学提出某种宇宙模型前也需要先作假设，可以帮助记忆 postulate，可以说 **postulate a theory — “An astronomer may postulate a theory about celestial motion and then compare it with repeated observations.”**

quiz.question: expostulate ____
quiz.explanation: 劝诫，劝诫。The teacher tried to expostulate with the student about his poor attendance. 老师试图就学生的出勤率不佳对他进行劝诫。 | ex->向外，postul->要求，expostulate->向外提出要求=劝诫（cf. postulate假定，remonstrate劝告，admonish告诫，exhort劝告） || 文化联想：老师面对屡次迟到的学生耐心劝诫，最适合联想到 expostulate，可以说 **expostulate with a student — “A teacher may expostulate with a student about repeated lateness and explain why the behavior must change.”**

quiz.question: amalgamate _____
quiz.explanation: 合并，合并公司。The two competing companies decided to amalgamate firms to increase market share. 两家竞争公司决定合并以增加市场份额。 | amalgam->汞合金（希腊，可能来自Arabic amalgam->联合），amalgamate->合并（cf. amalgam合金，merge合并，consolidate巩固，fuse融合） || 文化联想：近代商号或现代企业合并成更大机构最适合帮助记忆 amalgamate，可以说 **amalgamate two firms — “Two competing companies may amalgamate into a single larger firm in order to combine capital, staff, and markets.”**

quiz.question: __________ stalemate
quiz.explanation: 僵局，外交僵局。Negotiations reached a diplomatic stalemate with neither side willing to compromise. 谈判陷入外交僵局双方都不愿妥协。 | stale->僵停的位置（国际象棋术语），mate->将军，stalemate->不能移动的将军=僵局（cf. check将军，checkmate将死，impasse僵局） || 文化联想：楚汉相争在鸿沟对峙、双方一时谁也无法彻底击败对方，可以帮助记忆 stalemate，可以说 **a military stalemate — “When two armies face each other for months without a decisive breakthrough, the conflict can settle into a military stalemate.”**

quiz.question: decimate ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 大量毁灭，大量消灭队伍。The plague threatened to decimate the ranks of the army. 瘟疫威胁要大量消灭军队的队伍。 | decim->十分之一（拉丁decem->十），decimate->杀十分之一（古罗马军法中对叛乱部队每十人杀一人，cf. decimal小数，decade十年，December十二月） || 文化联想：一场严重瘟疫如果让一支军队大批减员，最适合联想到 decimate，可以说 **decimate the ranks — “A devastating epidemic can decimate the ranks of an army by killing or disabling a large share of its soldiers.”**

quiz.question: sublimate ______
quiz.explanation: 升华，升华欲望。The artist learned to sublimate desire into creative expression. 这位艺术家学会了将欲望升华为创造性表达。 | sub->在下，lim->门槛（拉丁limen），sublimate->越过门槛=升华（cf. sublime崇高=越过门槛，subliminal潜意识=在门槛以下，limit限制） || 文化联想：传统文人把失意、愤懑转化成诗画创作，最适合帮助记忆 sublimate，可以说 **sublimate emotion into art — “A frustrated scholar may sublimate grief or anger into poetry, calligraphy, or painting.”**

quiz.question: acclimate _______
quiz.explanation: 适应，快速适应。New employees were expected to acclimate quickly to the fast-paced work environment. 新员工被期望快速适应快节奏的工作环境。 | ac->朝向，climat->气候（希腊klima->倾斜），acclimate->适应气候=适应（cf. climate气候，acclimatize适应，adapt适应，climatology气候学） || 文化联想：北方人初到海南需要一段时间适应炎热潮湿的气候，最适合联想到 acclimate，可以说 **acclimate to the climate — “Someone arriving from northern China may need time to acclimate to Hainan’s heat and humidity.”**

quiz.question: inanimate ______
quiz.explanation: 无生命的，无生命的物体。The child's imagination brought the inanimate object to life in her story. 孩子的想象力在故事中赋予了无生命的物体生命。 | in->否定，anim->生命（拉丁anima），inanimate->无生命的（cf. animate有生命的，animal动物，animosity敌意，animated活跃的，anime动画） || 文化联想：中国画里的山石、器物虽然本身没有生命，却能通过笔墨显得有神韵，很适合联想到 inanimate，可以说 **an inanimate object — “In a skilled ink painting, even an inanimate object such as a rock or old vessel can seem full of character.”**
